content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Ohio State Football's PostOhio State Football Verified accountApril 13 at 6:15 PM · Shared with Public(Spring) Game week is FINALLY here April 18 B1G Network 12:00pm#GoBucks All reactions:1.8K67 comments360 sharesLikeCommentMost relevant Craig CadwalladerMy daughter played water polo a few years ago for the Buckeyes. They had the Big10 Tournament at McCorkle Pavilion the same weekend as the Scarlet and Grey game. Lousy weather, but I walked over to the Shoe and paid the $5. The place was packed. We're from California (USC alum) and all I could say was holy crap! Ohio State has been my second favorite team ever since.1w13Tim McgrathSo spring game and wrestlemania on same day!1w5Top fanTyler FriedrichCant wait to see everyone!1w7Linda Gross ClapperWhat’s the best time to arrive? We’ve been to games and always try to be there at least three hours before the game starts depending on who they’re playing. But I have no idea what all goes on before the spring game starts. I’m afraid if there’s nothing else going on that three hours would be way too soon. Unless the stands fill up fast in the general admission. Any suggestions would be greatly appreciated by anyone who’s been to the spring game before.
